name: Articulated track robot
one_liner: A rugged tracked robot that climbs obstacles and streams video over 4G.
intro: A tracked robot with articulated track modules, designed for industrial inspection, hazardous-environment reconnaissance and special-scenario exploration. It combines a pan-tilt HD camera with 4G remote control, so an operator can drive it and see what it sees from a distance, without anyone entering the space.

tech_stack.label: Chassis
tech_stack.value: Articulated tracked chassis, independent left/right tracks, swing-arm track modules, custom metal structure

tech_stack.label: Drive
tech_stack.value: High-torque motors and rugged drive system

tech_stack.label: Main controller
tech_stack.value: Embedded controller board (motion control, I/O, communication)

tech_stack.label: Camera
tech_stack.value: Pan-tilt (PTZ) camera, 360° view, auxiliary lighting

tech_stack.label: Link
tech_stack.value: 4G low-latency wireless link for remote control, HD video and telemetry

tech_stack.label: Power & safety
tech_stack.value: Power management, emergency stop, fault detection and alarm reporting

tech_stack.label: Operator software
tech_stack.value: PC / mobile control interface with live video, telemetry and status (battery, temperature, signal)

scope: Mechanical design of the articulated chassis, plus manufacturing and assembly
Hardware design: motor control, power system, main controller, sensors, 4G communication, video transmission
Embedded software: real-time motion control and motor coordination, swing-arm and PTZ camera control, sensor monitoring
Remote control software for PC and mobile: driving, camera operation, telemetry, manual and assisted modes

name: Flat-frame underwater ROV
one_liner: A light, tethered underwater robot with a gripper for inspection and sampling.
intro: A lightweight flat-frame underwater robot for inspection, research, rescue and demo use. A PETG frame holds a clear acrylic electronics chamber, multiple thrusters for omnidirectional movement and a single-axis waterproof gripper for simple grabbing and sampling. An operator drives it from a ground-station app with live video.

tech_stack.label: Motion control

tech_stack.label: Sensors

tech_stack.label: Camera
tech_stack.value: 1080p / 30 fps underwater camera with live video and recording

tech_stack.label: Structure
tech_stack.value: PETG frame, transparent acrylic pressure chamber, approx. 400 × 325 × 170 mm

tech_stack.label: Performance
tech_stack.value: Max operating depth 50 m, endurance up to 3 hours

tech_stack.label: Ground station

name: Large ROS inspection robot
one_liner: A large autonomous patrol robot that maps a building and drives itself.
intro: A ROS-based autonomous mobile inspection robot for campuses, factories, exhibition halls and other wide, flat indoor spaces. It builds a map with 360° lidar, plans its own patrol routes and avoids obstacles, and can also be driven remotely over 4G with live video. The open deck takes add-on payloads such as cameras, robotic arm modules or gas sensors.

name: Indoor delivery robot
one_liner: A 200 kg cargo cart that follows you or drives by remote.
intro: An indoor delivery robot for moving materials in factories, warehouses, labs and other indoor spaces. It follows a person wearing a UWB tag at a set distance, or can be driven with a handheld remote. Ultrasonic sensors stop it from running into obstacles, and it carries up to 200 kg in a lidded aluminium-frame box on four air-filled wheels.

tech_stack.value: ESP32 running FreeRTOS

tech_stack.label: Positioning
tech_stack.value: UWB modules front and rear (UART); follow distance 1–7 m, adjustable

tech_stack.label: Obstacle sensing

tech_stack.label: Camera
tech_stack.value: 1080p camera with video streaming and recording

tech_stack.label: Drive
tech_stack.value: 4WD differential drive, in-place turning, 10-inch air-filled tires, PID / S-curve motor control

tech_stack.label: Power

tech_stack.label: Load & speed
tech_stack.value: ≤200 kg payload, ≈30 kg empty, up to 5 km/h, ≤10° slope, 5 cm obstacles

name: Laser weeding robot
one_liner: A remote-driven robot that aims a high-power laser array at weeds.
intro: An agricultural service robot for row weeding and precision cutting with a high-power laser array. A four-wheel mobile base carries a laser beam that tilts on a single axis. An operator drives it remotely and aims through live video, and multi-channel safety interlocks guard the lasers. The system runs on ROS for mobility, control and teleoperation.
